name: AddToWishList
description: Clicks the 'Add to Wish List' button for a specified product.
precondition: The product is displayed on the page.
success_predicate: Click the 'Add to Wish List' button for the selected product. completed
action_template: Click the 'Add to Wish List' button for {product_name}.

execution_plan.fallback: Click the default 'Add to Wish List' button.
execution_plan.success_check: Verify that the button is clicked and the product is added to the wish list.

alternative_templates: Press the 'Add to Wish List' button for {product_name}.

name: HoverOverSearchMenu
description: Skill to hover over the visible 'Search' menu.
success_predicate: Hover over the visible 'Search' menu. completed

execution_plan.fallback: Wait and check again if the menu is not visible
execution_plan.success_check: Verify that the hover effect is applied to the 'Search' menu

alternative_templates: Point the cursor at the 'Search' menu.
